name: Hating Sim
source:
Avoid love at all costs!
What happens when you have a stereotypically annoying dating sim protagonist who wants to date you?

Impersonate a diligent student whose only purpose is to study as much as they can in the brief couple of days they've got before an important exam, and give the coldest of shoulders to the charming mouth-breather who's trying to take away from your study time with a sudden love story!

[From [url=https://guidomeo.itch.io/hating-sim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不惜一切代价避免爱情！
当你遇到一个典型的烦人的约会模拟主角想要和你约会时，会发生什么？

扮演一个勤奋的学生，唯一的目的就是在重要考试前的短短几天内尽可能多地学习，并以最冷漠的方式对待那些试图用突然的爱情故事夺走你学习时间的迷人的口呼吸者！

[来自[url=https://guidomeo.itch.io/hating-sim]Itch.io[/url]]
